all_summaries: The video discusses how artificial intelligence is transforming education by enabling interactive 3D anatomy applications and customized learning tools. It compares traditional static textbooks with dynamic AI-generated applications.

A speaker discusses how AI will transform education from static textbooks to interactive 3D applications, illustrated via a whiteboard drawing and a tweet card. The video argues that AI enables immersive, accurate learning tools instead of passive memorization and guesswork.

This video segment explains how AI will transform education from static textbooks into interactive applications, allowing students to visualize how things are built, and concludes with a call to follow for daily AI news and tutorials.
